notes.title: Mac and Steamdeck versions available now!
notes.content:
Mac OSX and Native Steamdeck are out!!!

YESSSSSSSSSS

they're out!!

hi!

super excited to announce that Tails Noir: Rebel Rush is available on Mac OSX and as a Native Steamdeck build starting from now!

we checked from our side and made sure that all achievements are achieving, leaderboards are working, and cloud saves are saving too!

steamdeck  players, take a note:

1. we're verifying the game with Steam, but it is not verified yet
2. it means that for now steamdeck will try to download the windows build
3. but what you really need is the linux build
4. so you need to go to the game properties and select "force the use of a specific Steam Play compatibility tool"

should look like this:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45079386/e874eba05abe2a74d7ea9a7c3e6662786034832a.jpg

drop us a line at discord if you have any questions!

enjoy,
dima

notes.title: Tails Noir: Rebel Rush day two patch update notes
notes.content:
update notes for build v. 3.2.3


 more reliable himbos! fixed a glitchy himbo behavior when they pulled the car to the side
 fewer road bumps! fixed road stitches causing car to get stuck
 better dialogues! fixed rare issues with font displays
 quality of life improvements! now in "rebel rush" mode music changes depending on the chapter of the game


no changes in levels or level layouts, nothing that can affect leaderboard scores

hope you're having fun!!
dima,
soup with friends

notes.title: Rebel Rush $1000 Speedrun Challenge starts in 1 day!
notes.content:
To all speedy racers of this world,

For the next trick we partnered with speedrun.com to run an official Rebel Rush Speedrun Challenge! With the prize fund and stuff!

For the next 4 days, the best of the best (including you!) will compete for the World Record of our crazy speedrunning platformer. The goal is to complete all the main 17 levels from start to finish, as fast as you possibly can.

Start: September 19th, 2024
Duration: 4 days, until 11:59PM UTC September 22nd, 2024

Full info, including the details about the contest and categories: [url=]https://www.speedrun.com/news/6o56x35p-rebel-rush-1000-speedrun-challenge

Prizes:

 1st place — $500
 2nd place — $300
 3rd place — $200

On top of that, each and every participant, no matter how fast or slow they are, will receive 1 copy of both Tails Noir and Tails Noir: Preludes. Get one for yourself or gift them to your friends!

Pro-tip: join the Tails Noir discord server, #speedrunning channel is cooking some really advanced techniques that will help you win!

push the pedal to the metal and go get what’s yours!
dima,
soup with friends

notes.title: Tails Noir: Rebel Rush day one patch update notes
notes.content:
update notes for build v. 3.1.1


 added mouse input: use left click for jump and right click for himbos
 fixed a weird bug with options screen getting stuck
 fixed a surreal bug with himbo usage in pause menu
 fixed a eerie behavior in a dialogue display order


no changes in levels or level layouts, nothing that can affect leaderboard scores

thanks for all the kind words and steam reviews!
dima,
soup with friends
